'''0.15a''' is a major update for [[Survarium]] that made item weight affect the player's movement speed and damage dropoff.

==Changelog==
* Added dependence of character's movement and drain of energy from the weight of their equipment
* Added piercing to materials
* Add a dependency on bullet damage from the distance to the target
* Added ability to bring several types of ammunition for a weapon in combat
* Added damage scale on the icon for your character in battle (yellow - great damage , red - critical)
* Removed debug information (camera_position, crosshair_distance)
* Removed a debug display of fire points for weapons

===Bug fixes===
* Fixed lighting bug on "[[Rudnya]]" location
* Fixed game crash when pressing Alt
* Fixed overflow error in the queue of playing sounds
* Fixed multiple synchronization errors, including:
* Fixed synchronization using first aid kits
* Fixed synchronization when jumping
* Fixed synchronization when shooting
* Fixed ability to accelerate and jump with insufficient stamina
